# zailc's public surface, generated by `bun run tools/release/surface.ts --write`. Never edit
# by hand. A change to it is a re-baseline in its OWN commit, with the reason (releasing.md).
artifact executable zailc-gen
artifact library pizlo-stock
artifact library yoloc
artifact library yolort
artifact library yolounwind
build-option -Dfilc-src = []const u8
build-option -Dpizfix = []const u8
build-step compiler-rt
build-step gen
build-step libpas
build-step test
build-step yolomusl
cli zailc-gen --version
cli zailc-gen <path ending in filc_native.h or filc_native_forwarders.c>
cli zailc-gen forwarders <out.c>
cli zailc-gen header <out.h>
cli zailc-gen musl-genh <musl-src> <out-dir> [arch=x86_64]
cli zailc-gen musl-headers <musl-src> <out-dir> [arch=x86_64]
cli-exit 2
cli-version-line zailc-gen {s}
env ZAILC_FILC_PREBUILT
env ZAILC_FILC_SRC
env ZAILC_ZIG
env ZAILC_ZILC
env ZAILC_ZILC_FILC
